spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (उर्दते)
1 To measure.
2 To play.
3 To be easy or cheerful.

m. (-र्द्रः)
An otter.
E.
उर्द to play, रन् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 A hero, a champion.
2 A Rākṣasa, a goblin or fiend.
E.
ऊर्ज to be strong. दरल् Uṇādi affix; ज is dropped.

mfn. (-र्द्धः-र्द्धा-र्द्धं)
1 Above, upper.
2 High, elevated.
3 Abandoned: see ऊर्द्ध्व.

m. (-कः)
A kind of drum: see ऊर्द्ध्वक.

mfn. (-ऊर्द्ध्वः-ऊर्द्ध्वा-ऊर्द्ध्वं)
1 Above, superior, upper.
2

High.
3

Abandoned.
4

After, subsequent.
E.
ऊर् substituted for उद् above, हा to leave, and ड्व affix, or with ड only ऊर्द्ध्वं.

m. (-कः)
A kind of drum.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व or ऊर्द्ध्व up, and क what sounds; from its making a loud noise, or being elevated in playing; also ऊर्द्धक.

m. (-यः)
The upper part of the body.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and काय body.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Going up or above; ascending, hovering.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and ग what goes; also ऊर्द्ध्वगामिन्, &c.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Gone up, risen, ascended.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व, गत gone.

f. (-तिः)
Ascent, elevation.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and गति going.

n. (-रं)
The city of HARIŚCANDRA, who with his subjects is supposed to be suspended in the atmosphere.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्वग going above, and पुर a city: see हरिश्चन्द्रपुर.

m. (-मः)
Upward motion of any kind.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and गम going; also ऊर्द्ध्वगति.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Supine, heels upwards.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and चरण the foot; also ऊर्द्ध्वपाद, &c.

mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु)
1 Thick-kneed, long-shanked.
2 Sitting on the hams.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व high, large, जानु the knee, and with कन् added ऊर्द्ध्वजानुक.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Thick-kneed: see the preceding.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and ज्ञ substituted for जानु; also ऊर्द्ध्वज्ञ.

mfn. (-ज्ञुः-ज्ञुः-ज्ञु)
See the preceding.

n. (-त्वं)
Height, elevation.
E.
त्व added to ऊर्द्ध्व; also with तल्, ऊर्द्ध्वता.

mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि)
Looking up or upwards.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and दृष्टि sight.

m. (-वः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व superior, and देव a deity.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Exalted, elevated.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व upper, दम to tame, and अप् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Causing to ascend.
2 Sublimation.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and पातन causing to go.

n. (-त्रं)
A sacrificial vessel.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and पात्र a vessel.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Heels upwards.
m. (-दः)
A fabulous animal with eight legs.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व superior, exceeding, and पाद a foot.

m. (-ण्ड्रः)
A perpendicular line on the forehead made with Sandal, &c. a Vaiṣṇava mark.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व above, पुण्ड्र a similar mark.

n. (-हुः)
An ascetic, one who holds his arms above his head constantly till they are fixed in that position.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and वाहु the arm.

m. (-ताः)
1 A name of Ś

IVA.
2
Of BHĪṢ

MA.
3

A description of saint, one who lives in perpetual chastity.
E.
उर्द्ध्व up, above, and रेतस् semen virile.

m. (-ङ्गः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and लिङ्ग the generative organ.

m. (-कः)
Svarga, the heaven of INDRA or paradise.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व, and लोक a world: the world above.

m. (-त्मा)
The atmosphere, heaven.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व above, and वर्त्मन् a path.

m. (-युः)
The wind in the upper part of the body.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and वायु wind.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Put on, above or over the head.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and वृत worn.

n. (-नं)
Vomiting.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and शोधन purifying.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Above, superior, placed on high; also ऊर्द्ध्वस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं).
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व and स्थ what stays or is.

f. (-तिः)
1 A horse's back, the part where the rider sits.
2 Elevation, superiority.
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व above, and स्थिति being, staying.

m. (तः)
The name of a vegetable, (Momordica charantia.)
E.
ऊर्द्ध्व above, आसित thrown: raised above other fruits.
